_meta.purpose: Closed-loop driving-score objective for B4 three-arm co-design search
_meta.task: B4 closed-loop axis — overnight model-only deliverable

assessment.summary: Model-only deliverable. NO new closed-loop sims run tonight. Pyramid closed-loop is NOT runnable (CARLA not installed locally; V2Xverse migration pending). All closed-loop data is from CoDriving on H800.

data_inventory.description: 18-point tau_perc curve (0-1000ms), CoDriving model, H800, N=105 per point, 35 routes matched
data_inventory.notes: HIGH NOISE in 50-500ms range (non-monotone between adjacent points, CI ±3-5 DS). Signal only clear at >500ms scale.

data_inventory.description: 3-point tau_perc curve (0/200/500ms), CoDriving, N=141 matched per point
Single-route RouteScenario_0 runs at 0ms and 108ms delay, DS=100 for both
data_inventory.notes: Single route, single repeat, both DS=100 — NOT discriminative for latency curve fitting

assessment.ap70_to_ds_data: NONE. No paired AP70 / driving-score experiments exist. AP70 term uses assumed power-law (see below). Default beta=0 (latency-only) is most defensible.
assessment.pyramid_closedloop_readiness: NOT READY. CARLA not installed locally. V2Xverse migration to Pyramid pending (multi-stage). Cannot run Pyramid closed-loop sims tonight.

e2e_latency_anchors.fixed_overhead_note: pre-body(vox+enc+backbone_FP32_PyTorch)=78.96ms + NMS=8.54ms. Constant across TRT precision variants (only TRT body changes). Source: E8 D1_B2_FP32_v2 + D2 synthesis.

tau_300.note: noisier region — model slightly optimistic at 300ms

caveats: Data is from CoDriving, applied as-is to Pyramid. Assumed sensitivity curve shape is transferable; absolute DS levels may differ.
High noise in 50-500ms range (CI ±3-5 DS). For B4 configs in 108-219ms e2e range, expected DS spread is ~3-7 points — within noise floor.
Model derived from V2Xverse full-traffic (_1) scenario, 35 matched routes. Urban mixed-traffic context.
Do NOT use for absolute DS values; use for RELATIVE ranking of configs in B4 search.

scale_calibration.note: Linear calibration using base-tuned as anchor. ASSUMPTION: TRT body latency scales proportionally with H800 backbone latency across widths. This is an approximation — in reality the body includes fusion+head overhead which don't scale with backbone width. Treat as ±30% rough estimate for non-base configs.

p75.note: p75 real is INT8 only (107.5ms); FP32 p75 body not measured on Orin

trap25.note: HIGH UNCERTAINTY — 3.4x base backbone → very high latency estimate

pad64.note: ≈ base latency (pad64 tuned ≈ base tuned on H800)

iso_s0.note: HIGH UNCERTAINTY — iso_s0 = s0 misaligned = ~trap25 latency class

ap70_correction.beta_note: beta=0 (latency-only) is the RECOMMENDED default for B4 — no AP70→DS data exists. beta=0.5 gives a mild correction: p75 (AP70=0.530) gets DS * 0.917 factor. Set via query arg.
ap70_correction.max_ap70_correction_at_beta05: p75 vs base: DS × 0.917 = 8% penalty at same latency

ds_config_table_fp32_tuned.note: DS predictions using DS_lat(e2e_ms, beta=0) for tuned schedule, FP32 scale. AP70 from B2/stage_a real data.

b4_plugin_recommendation.objective_direction: MAXIMIZE driving_score (add as -driving_score to minimization vector)
b4_plugin_recommendation.default_mode: latency_only (beta=0) — most defensible given no AP70->DS data
b4_plugin_recommendation.sensitivity_mode: beta=0.5 — optional, clearly labeled as assumed
b4_plugin_recommendation.scale_tier: fp32 for default B4 run (B4 uses H800 TVM, not Orin TRT; use fp32 as closest proxy to TRT FP32 body scaling)
b4_plugin_recommendation.key_ranking_insight: trap25/iso_s0 (tuned) have ~535ms e2e → DS≈87. pad64 (tuned) has ~215ms → DS≈96. BASE same as pad64 (~219ms, DS≈96). The DS axis DISCRIMINATES trap25 vs pad64 in B4 — supporting the structural claim (W_g=trap25 is slow=low DS, P_g=pad64 is fast=high DS at same AP70=0.590).
b4_plugin_recommendation.warning: DS spread between base/pad64/iso_s1/iso_s2 (all ~215-240ms) is <1 DS point — not discriminative. Only trap25/iso_s0 are clearly separated (~87 vs ~96). Use DS axis primarily as a discriminator for misaligned-width configs.
b4_plugin_recommendation.implementation_note: Add 3rd objective -DS to CostModel.evaluate() tuple. Extend hypervolume to 3D or report DS separately as a non-dominated sorting tiebreaker.
